item.tib: khyung sgrub dregs pa zil gnon kyi dbang khrid ye shes me dpung
item.coloph: ces pa'i drag po khyung gi sgrub pa las/ dbang bskur ba'i rim pa 'di yang / mtshan ldan bla ma 7spyang bla rin po che mnyam med tshul khrims dbang grags mchog gi bka' gsung phebs (phab)pa dang / ma zad bka' slob tshul khrims blo gros dang / dge rgan bstan 'dzin blo gros sogs kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ tshe dbang bla ma'i rjes 'bring tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du/ rig 'dzin stong rgyung nyid kyi zhal lung bzhin du dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o//
